name: FRP server
summary: Advice for an FRP server using its existing command and configuration.

recommendations.reason: tired policy for a continuously running server: retry after clean exits too. The upstream systemd example does not specify this restart policy.
The upstream server example orders startup after network.target. This does not require network-online.target.

advisories.message: Preserve frps -c and the supplied configuration path. No configuration is generated or rewritten.
Root and capability requirements depend on the selected server configuration. No privilege grant or descriptor limit is inferred.
Network ordering is system-scope advice and does not monitor ongoing connectivity.
